messages:
Ellis Park: Quick life update — I got promoted to Staff SWE today 🎉 and also... we’re expecting a baby in August! Wanted to share the chaos with you all.
Maya Chen: WHAT!! omg ellis!! double congrats ❤️❤️❤️ :celebrate: so proud!!
Samir Patel: Two huge milestones!!! congrats 😭👏 When's the due date? we need a cake poll.
Ellis Park: Due date is Aug 14. Cake poll absolutely mandatory. Also low-key panicking about baby names and sleep.
Gita Fernández: Congrats!! I can put together a digital card and get folks to sign. Ellis — do you have a registry or links?
Ellis Park: Thanks gita, yes here's the registry: https://example.com/ellis-registry (feel free to share).
Mateo Rivera: Congrats Ellis!!! Can we do a virtual baby shower? timezone-friendly on a Friday afternoon PT?
Maya Chen: thumbs up from me. I can host on Zoom and bring a terrible baby trivia quiz.
People Ops Bot: Friendly reminder: team celebratory budget can cover a $60 gift per person. Please coordinate with #people-ops for approvals.
Gita Fernández: I'll start a doodle for times and a Google doc for gift ideas. Also, @Ellis Park any food allergies we should know about for the IRL cake run?
Ellis Park: No allergies, and I am NOT picky. Chocolate or lemon will make me tear up with happiness.
Samir Patel: Suggestion: giant confetti balloon drop gif in the thread + we get Mateo to bake something questionable.
Mateo Rivera: I’ll attempt banana bread. No guarantees.
Maya Chen: vote for banana bread + lemon cake tie-breaker.
Gita Fernández: Card and gift plan coming this week. Congrats again Ellis — we’re so happy for you ❤️
Ellis Park: Thanks team. Feeling very lucky. Also accepting terrible parenting advice in DMs.
